hyps.why: Undertrained low learning rates benefit from a larger step within 243 epochs.
Already-large learning rates become unstable when raised further.
Lowering an excessive learning rate restores stable training.
Already strong L2 regularization causes underfitting when increased further.
Reducing an overly strong L2 penalty relieves underfitting.
Deeper nets are more unstable at high learning rates.
Shallower nets tolerate high learning rates better.
Small batches give many more updates, and fewer updates hurt when increasing batch size from a low value.
Hypothesized weak pattern: from large batches, a smaller batch adds noisy updates with little gain.
Wide nets with stronger L2 lose accuracy in the sampled runs.
